title: EventBus listener removal and registration during emit contract

contract.emit_snapshot: Each emit operates on a snapshot of the listener registry taken before delivery
contract.current_emit_isolation: Removing or registering listeners during an active emit does not alter the current delivery snapshot
contract.removal_effect: A listener removed during one emit remains active for that current emit but is absent from subsequent emits
contract.registration_effect: A listener registered during one emit does not receive that current event but participates in subsequent emits
contract.mutation_combination: Remove and register operations may occur during the same callback without corrupting the registry
contract.ordering: Existing listeners retain deterministic order and newly registered listeners are appended
contract.idempotent_registration: Repeated registration of the same plugin and callback does not create duplicate registry entries
contract.idempotent_removal: Removing an already removed listener returns False without mutating the registry
contract.source_integrity: Source payloads remain unchanged after emit and registry mutation
